name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Wade's weight is between the angler at Foxglen and the angler who landed the Trout.
The angler at Stillwater's weight is at least 2 lb more than Boone.
Exactly one member of the Catfish Family is in the South Watershed.
The angler who landed the Trout's weight is at least 2 lb more than Royce.
Royce does not belong to the Pike Family.
The angler at Pinehollow's weight is between Boone and the angler who landed the Crappie.
